configurePresets.name: ecs3d-debug
configurePresets.description: Debug build with assertions live. What CI exercises alongside release, and the configuration the check target is normally run under. Writes to cmake-build-ecs3d-debug.

configurePresets.name: ecs3d-release
configurePresets.description: Optimized build. The configuration the engine is run and profiled in, and the second build type CI covers. Writes to cmake-build-ecs3d-release.

configurePresets.name: ecs3d-sanitize
configurePresets.description: Debug plus AddressSanitizer, and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer where the toolchain has it (Clang and GCC; MSVC ships ASan only). Aimed at the headless test suite; see the README for why the apps are a different matter. Precompiled headers are off, so the CI rows on this preset also catch a file that leans on the PCH for an include it does not make itself. Writes to cmake-build-ecs3d-sanitize.

configurePresets.name: ecs3d-coverage
configurePresets.description: Debug instrumented for line and branch coverage (--coverage on Clang and GCC, /PROFILE on MSVC). Aimed at the test suites; CI runs it on Linux gcc and publishes a report. Writes to cmake-build-ecs3d-coverage.
